about.headline: About Me
paragraphs: I'm Mario 'Keyz' Aquino, a Senior Full-Stack Developer based in Resistencia, Argentina, with a deep passion for backend architecture, distributed systems, and the intersection of AI with modern software development.

Over the past 6+ years, I've built everything from real-time collaboration platforms to enterprise-grade web scrapers. I thrive on optimizing performance, reducing infrastructure costs, and crafting systems that scale gracefully under pressure.

Currently, I'm focused on AI-driven automation — integrating LLMs, building intelligent scraping pipelines, and creating developer tools that amplify team productivity. I'm actively seeking opportunities with US startups where I can make an immediate impact as a Backend Developer, AI Developer, or Founding Engineer.
When I'm not coding, I'm expanding my knowledge in cyber defense, contributing to open-source projects, or exploring the latest advances in AI/ML engineering.
